recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一個圓形、極深染且幾乎無細胞質的巨核細胞裸核，下方連著成群血小板碎片；上方可見一顆與紅血球等大的巨大血小板，背景紅血球大小不一並有少數淚滴細胞，提示骨髓纖維化。
features: Round, very dense, hyperchromatic naked megakaryocyte nucleus with minimal cytoplasm
Platelet fragments clustered at the edge of the bare nucleus
Giant platelet approaching the size of a red cell with pale, finely granular cytoplasm
Anisocytosis with occasional teardrop cells, a large polychromatic cell and elliptocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild to moderate anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop cells, elliptocytes and a large polychromatophilic red cell. A small, round, hyperchromatic nucleus with minimal cytoplasm and adherent platelet fragments is present, consistent with a circulating naked megakaryocyte nucleus. A giant platelet approximately the size of a red cell is also seen. Findings are consistent with the peripheral blood picture of primary myelofibrosis, with correlation with marrow biopsy and MPN driver mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes show a visible rim of blue cytoplasm and less opaque chromatin, and lack attached budding platelet fragments.
A normoblast has a small pyknotic nucleus surrounded by pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not platelet fragments.
ET shows giant platelets and thrombocytosis but lacks teardrop poikilocytosis and circulating megakaryocyte nuclei.
Marrow infiltration by tumor or granulomas gives the same leukoerythroblastic features; distinction requires marrow biopsy.
